'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Aaron Nelson LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Nelson]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
